Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12353 of 2024
Applicant :- Suraj

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Mukesh Baghel
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Pawan Kumar, advocate holding brief of Sri Mukesh Baghel, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri RN Mishra, learned AGA for the State.
2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.628 of 2023, under Sections 399, 402, 414, 420, 468, 471 IPC & 15 of Dacoity Affected Area Act,
Police Station Jagdishpura, District Agra, during pendency of the trial.
3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and six others and according to the FIR,
applicant and other accused persons were making planning to commit dacoity and from the possession of the applicant countrymade pistol was also recovered.
4.

sentences.text: 5. He further submits, along with applicant as many as six persons were made accused and four have already been released on bail and bail orders of two co-accused have been annexed with the instant bail application.

6. He further submits, apart from the present case, applicant is having criminal history of five other cases but his criminal history has been explained in the instant bail application and in all the cases,
applicant
is on bail.
He next submits that applicant is in jail since 6.12.2023.

7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits, apart from the present case,
applicant is having criminal history of seven other cases but criminal history of only five cases has been explained but he fairly conceded that both the cases were of minor nature.
Learned AGA further could not dispute the other arguments of facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, apart from the present case, it appears that applicant is having criminal history of seven other cases but in all the cases, he is on bail and it appears that in majority of the cases, he was made accused by the police.

As far as the merits of the present case is concerned only allegation against the applicant is that he along with six other accused persons were making planning to commit dacoity and from the possession of the applicant, one country made pistol along with cartridges were recovered but story narrated by the prosecution does not appear to be convincing.

Further,
along with the applicant six other accused persons were also made accused and four have already been released on bail.
Further, in the present matter applicant is in jail since 6.12.2023.

10. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

12. Let the applicant - Suraj be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
